# PawScribe

> PawScribe is an AI scribe for veterinarians. It turns messy exam notes and dictation into clean, structured SOAP notes in seconds — right in the browser, with no app to install. Notes are saved only in the browser; text sent for AI drafting is not stored by PawScribe.

## Pages

- [Home](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/index.html): What PawScribe does, how it works, and why vets save time on notes.
- [Templates](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/templates.html): Ready-made SOAP note templates for common vet visits.
- [Write a note](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/app.html): The free in-browser scribe — paste notes, get a structured SOAP draft.
- [Dashboard](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/dashboard.html): Saved notes and account overview for signed-in users.
- [Sign in](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/auth.html): Sign in or create a PawScribe account.
- [Pricing](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/pricing.html): Free, Pro ($49/month per vet), and Clinic ($119/month) plans.
- [About](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/about.html): Who builds PawScribe and why.
- [Privacy](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/privacy.html): How PawScribe handles your data — notes stay in your browser unless you choose otherwise.
- [Terms](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/terms.html): Terms of use for PawScribe.
- [Contact](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/contact.html): Get in touch with the PawScribe team.
- [How to Write a SOAP Note](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/how-to-write-a-soap-note.html): A practical guide to writing clear Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan sections.
- [Veterinary SOAP Note Template](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/veterinary-soap-note-template.html): A copy-ready SOAP template for veterinary exams.
- [How to Save Time on Vet Notes](https://alvarado509.github.io/pawscribe/how-to-save-time-on-vet-notes.html): Workflow tips to cut charting time without cutting corners.
